Three members of an '''unidentified simian species''' were among the prisoners of [[Stars' End/Legends|Stars' End]], freed during the [[Liberation of Stars' End]] in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]. This species had long arms and great strength, and were able to swing and climb with skill. One of the simians was killed by [[Security Police/Legends|Security Police]] during their escape. The other two swarmed the policeman, and their strength was great enough to hurl him against a high ceiling with ease.
